card.name: Inside clinical trial names
card.fires_on: Partway through the name or number code of a named clinical trial or study, such as TAX324, MARIPOSA, EORTC 26101 or ANDROMEDA, just before the trial is described.

modes.description: Digits or letters inside a trial identifier code.

modes.label: Trial name pieces
modes.description: A piece of a trial acronym or a word leading into a named study.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like experiment and experimental, so it adds a sense that a study is being named.
card.plain: It fires inside the names and codes of clinical trials, just as the text is about to describe the study.
